definition.simple: When light hits a surface and bounces off, just like a rubber ball bouncing off a wall.
definition.academic: The change in direction of a wavefront at an interface between two different media so that the wavefront returns into the medium from which it originated.

examples: Seeing your face in a mirror.
Moonlight shining on a calm lake.
Glare on your phone screen from the sun.

common_misconceptions: Thinking reflection only happens on mirrors (it happens on all visible objects, just scattered).
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student to imagine throwing a tennis ball against a smooth wall.
